title: Audio evidence upload
responsibility: Adds a single recording or paired before-and-after audio evidence to a report.

inputs.name: UploadAudio.reportId
inputs.description: Required report identifier included in submitted form data.

inputs.name: UploadAudio.onUploaded
inputs.description: Required callback receiving the returned report after a 201 response with an evidence array.

outputs.name: UploadAudio
outputs.description: Expandable audio upload form with single/comparison modes, required title up to 120 characters, optional source up to 200 and notes up to 2000. Rejects selected files above 50,000,000 bytes before posting. Controls lock during upload; failures appear in status text. Success resets fields and file pickers while retaining the mode.
